name: openqr-wordpress
description: Official OpenQR WordPress plugin: create, manage and print QR codes from wp-admin.

scripts.build: wp-scripts build src/blocks/qr/index.js --output-path build/blocks/qr && node bin/copy-assets.js
scripts.plugin-check: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/openqr wp plugin check --strict ./
